name: noop-runner
_notes: Built-in platform-owned fixture workload (sandbox/fixtures/noop) — not an application workload. Used to prove the generic invocation mechanism and to drive the harness's own limit-enforcement tests via payload.mode (crash/hang/memory_hog) without needing a second fixture. Conforms to the Contract C manifest shape (contracts/workload/v1/workload.json) so it exercises the exact same registry/invocation path a real workload like connection-embedding will use.
